status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issue #523 (ADR-0040); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: Scores of the design's intent — whether each decision is grounded, whether each criterion's verification fits it and whether the scope is right — never the method by which the design was reached. A re-score, given the previous evaluation, states which items it scored afresh and which it inherited.
procedure: docs/evaluation-system.md > Gate rubrics — GATE:HYPOTHESIS, GATE:PLAN, AUDIT, GATE:QUALITY > GATE:PLAN

previous_evaluation.note: previous_evaluation is given on a re-score; its unchanged items are inherited by citation.

evaluation.note: the evaluator, writing into the output directory its prompt names (Q7, revised 2026-10-26)

scores.note: each value a number 0-10, or { score, reason }

rescore.note: on a re-score: the items scored afresh (rescored) and the items inherited (inherited), and what became of the previous evaluation's findings (prior_findings) — docs/evaluation-system.md > Evaluation Output Format

checks.note: Q2: the evaluation outputs scores and their grounds; the pass values travel in reference

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/core.md > Development Lifecycle; ADR-0040 D1).

reference.note: Q2: AutoFlow provides these with the evaluation, which outputs its scores and their grounds against them.
